FLASHSCORE PREVIEW

Two of the Bundesliga’s most out-of-form sides clash this weekend as Cologne and Elversberg desperately search for a much-needed victory.

Match News and Current Form

With just two wins to their name from their opening ten Bundesliga matches this season (D4, L4), Cologne begin this latest matchday sat dangerously close to the bottom three. An ongoing five-match winless run in Germany’s top-flight (D3, L2) leaves them with the competition’s joint-second lowest return across that period, though picking up eight of their ten points this term on home soil (W2, D2, L1) suggests a return to familiar surroundings will be welcomed. The opposition may not though, as Cologne have only won one of their last six Bundesliga matches against promoted sides (D3, L2).

A 1-0 defeat to high-flying Freiburg last time out saw Elversberg crash to a third defeat in four Bundesliga matches as the reality of their promotion begins to kick in. Since the start of October, only one Bundesliga side has lost more matches than their five across all competitions, with that return hampered by their leaky defensive line which has failed to keep a single clean sheet across their seven matches during that timeframe. There’s still reason for optimism as Elversberg start the round six points clear of the bottom three, but having lost their last three away league games for the first time since January 2024, that cushion could be eaten into this weekend.

Head-to-Head History

Cologne and Elversberg have only met twice before, with Cologne holding the slight edge (W1, D1) after winning the only prior H2H they hosted.

Win Probability
Opta by StatsPerform
Hot Stats and Streaks

Eight of Cologne’s ten Bundesliga games this season saw both teams score.

Only two sides have received more yellow cards than Cologne (24) in the Bundesliga this season.

Elversberg’s last four away league games were goalless at half-time.

Elversberg have attempted the second-fewest shots in the Bundesliga this season (111).

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Linton Maina assisted the winner in Cologne’s last H2H, and his last four strikes for the club have all arrived before the hour mark on home soil. Felix Keidel has recorded five Bundesliga goal contributions for Elversberg this term (G2, A3), with four of his last five goals coming on the road and after the 60th minute.

Cologne are in the midst of an injury crisis which is headlined by number one goalkeeper Marvin Schwäbe, though visiting Elversberg arrive here with no fresh concerns of their own.

For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre. 

Betting Analysis

With Cologne missing multiple starters through injury and both sides struggling for overall recent form, the draw market looks enticing here. 

Author: Nathan Evans
